todo_file.description: Path to the markdown task list file

working_directory.description: Working directory for agent CLI and verification commands

prompt_template.description: Path to the prompt template file (must contain {{TASK}})

subprocess_timeout.description: Wall-clock timeout per task in seconds (null = no limit)

stall_timeout_seconds.description: Activity-based timeout — kills task only if no CPU/file activity for this long

max_retries_per_provider.description: Retry attempts per provider on non-rate-limit failures

tasks_per_batch.description: Bundle up to this many pending tasks into a single agent invocation and a single verify_commands run, amortizing build/test overhead across them. Completion is all-or-nothing for the whole batch.

require_manual_confirmation.description: If true, prompt for approval after each task attempt

continue_on_failure.description: If false, stop on the first task that cannot be completed

on_failure.description: Behavior when a task fails: skip (leave unchecked, move on), defer (move to end of file), stop (halt orchestrator)

auto_commit.description: Automatically git commit after each completed task

verify_commands.description: Shell commands that must all exit 0 for a task to be verified

verify_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock timeout for each verify_commands entry (null = no limit). A hanging build/test command has no other backstop -- it runs after the agent's own subprocess has already exited, so stall detection doesn't cover it.

dashboard_port.description: Port for the local status dashboard (null = disabled)

interactive_commands.description: Enable p/s/q/r keyboard commands during runs

rate_limit_patterns.description: Lowercase substrings indicating rate-limit in CLI output
